content:
Gate Entry/Exit Dashboard: Upon vehicle entry, the system uses GPS technology to gather comprehensive vehicle data. If driver details are already recorded, they will be displayed on the dashboard; otherwise, there is an option to manually input the driver's information. This real-time data collection enhances compliance with safety standards and improves operational transparency, streamlining the gate entry process and providing better visibility and control for efficient plant management.

AI True Lead Distance: AI True Lead Distance calculates the precise distance between origin and destination with 99.9% accuracy. By using advanced algorithms, it resolves GPS jump issues in real-time, ensuring consistent and reliable data for optimal route planning and analysis. This innovative approach enhances efficiency and accuracy in distance measurement.

AI True Halts/Locations: AI True Halts/Locations identifies and classifies the specific types of stops made during shipment transit, such as dhabas, petrol pumps, and general parking areas. By accurately pinpointing these halt locations, the system provides detailed insights into the journey, helping optimize route planning and improve overall efficiency during transit.

Geofence/ Toll Visibility: Geofence Visibility offers detailed insights into toll costs incurred during shipment transit. By mapping out geofenced toll zones, the system provides real-time data on approximate tariffs, aiding in budgeting and route optimization. This feature is recommended for precise cost management and enhanced efficiency during transportation.

Deviation Clusters: Deviation Clusters provide clear insights into delivery route deviations by analyzing location, distance, and impact percentage. This data helps identify areas where deviations occur, allowing for targeted improvements in route planning. By understanding these clusters, businesses can enhance efficiency, minimize costs, and improve overall delivery performance.

Xsight Dashboard: The Xsight Dashboard empowers management with quick and efficient decision-making capabilities. By presenting real-time data and actionable insights in a clear, user-friendly format, the dashboard streamlines analysis and supports informed choices. This enhances operational control and strategic planning, leading to improved performance and productivity.

section_title: Going beyond real-time visibility (unified platform for logistics)
breadcrumb: Respondent Information > Axestrack Expertise & Recognitions > Going beyond real-time visibility (unified platform for logistics)
content:
Axestrack with its suite of products (xSwift, Connected Plant Logistics, Managed Control Tower, Connected Plant Logistics, etc.) provides state-of-the-art tracking and visibility to shippers and fleet owners.

The unified, single-pane view across all platforms facilitates rapid and informed decision-making. This connected operating system is structured into three key layers: See, Understand & Learn, and Act.

The See layer aggregates data from multiple sources, including third-party GPS/Telematics systems, 3PL providers, ERP/TMS platforms, toll systems, government portals, OEM systems, third-party SIMs, and open APIs. This data is consolidated into a comprehensive data pool via a robust integration layer.

The Understand & Learn layer leverages advanced AI and machine learning capabilities to transform this data lake into a data pool, enabling deeper insights and meaningful analytics.

The Act layer presents this processed data through unified platforms, offering actionable analytics and reports. These insights empower the Managed Control Tower to make real-time interventions, ensuring efficient operations and improved outcomes.

breadcrumb: Proposed Solution > Our Understanding of Ather Energy Business Process > As-is Process
content:
Ather Energy currently manages its truck movement and material validation processes manually at the Security Gate, Vehicle Plant, and Battery Plant. The process begins with manual checks of vehicles at the security gate, where material and invoice validations are conducted. Following this, details are manually entered into JIRA, and a handwritten slip is created for the truck driver, indicating the destination. At junction points, security personnel manually guide drivers based on the slip, directing them to the designated docks for unloading. This reliance on manual processes leads to significant inefficiencies and operational challenges.

The diagram below illustrates the current As-is flow at Ather Energy

One of the primary issues is the high Truck TAT, with invoice validation at the gate often taking 2-3 hours. These delays cause truck drivers to park their vehicles in open areas and take extended breaks, creating further bottlenecks. Security personnel must then manually coordinate with the drivers to move trucks, increasing their workload. Additionally, there are frequent mismatches and miscommunications between dock operations teams and gate administration staff, complicating workflows and delaying material movement. The lack of a digital system also limits real-time visibility into truck and material tracking, while manual data entry into JIRA increases the risk of errors and consumes valuable time.

breadcrumb: Proposed Solution > Our Understanding of Ather Energy Business Process > To-be Process
content:
To address above challenges, Axestrack proposes implementing its "Connected Plant Logistics" (CPL) solution for Ather Energy. This solution automates the critical stages of truck-in, Unloading, and truck-out processes using advanced hardware such as RFID readers, PA systems, LED displays, and boom barriers. CPL will streamline the validation process, enabling faster and more accurate gate-in checks. By integrating directly with Ather’s ERP or Ariba systems, the solution eliminates the need for manual data entry into JIRA. All data points will be automatically captured and pushed to the ERP system, ensuring seamless operations and reducing the risk of human error.

The diagram below illustrates the To-be flow progression through various checkpoints for Ather Energy

The implementation of CPL will significantly reduce truck turnaround times, optimize material tracking, and enhance process transparency through a robust digital layer. Real-time tracking of trucks and materials will provide end-to-end visibility, while automated systems will improve coordination between dock operations and gate administration teams. By automating driver management and truck movement, CPL will ensure smoother operations, reducing delays caused by manual interventions. Furthermore, CPL will capture comprehensive data for audits and reports, enabling Ather Energy to gain actionable insights and maintain a detailed operational record.

Overall, the adoption of Axestrack's CPL solution will transform Ather Energy's logistics operations, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and providing a modern, automated framework for managing truck and material movements. This system will address current inefficiencies while future-proofing Ather’s logistics processes for sustained operational excellence.

CPL will address the core requirements of Ather Energy by providing the following functionalities:

Automation of Truck Processes:

Automating the truck-in, unloading, and truck-out processes through CPL.

Installation of hardware components such as RFID readers, boom barriers, PA systems, and LED displays at critical checkpoints.

System Integration:

Seamless integration of CPL with Ather Energy’s existing ERP system (or Ariba) to enable real-time data validation, data exchange, and material tracking.

Elimination of manual data entry into JIRA by automating the transfer of all captured data points directly to the ERP system.

Material Validation and Tracking:

Digital validation of truck details, invoices, and materials at the security gate.

Implementation of a real-time tracking system to monitor the movement of trucks and materials across different plants.

Driver Guidance and Coordination:

Automated communication of dock assignments to drivers via digital slips and LED displays.

Reduced dependency on manual guidance by security personnel, streamlining the coordination process.

Reporting and Auditing:

Automated capture of operational data for generating audit trails and detailed reports.

Provision of fortnightly reporting and actionable insights to support operational decision-making and continuous improvement.

Enhanced Security and Efficiency:

Implementation of automated boom barriers to regulate truck entry and exit.

Streamlining communication between gate administration and dock operations teams to resolve operational mismatches and improve coordination.

Reduction in Turnaround Time (TAT):

Minimizing truck processing time at the gate to ensure quicker entry and reducing bottlenecks.

Streamlining operations across various stages to enable faster movement and reduction in delays.

Operational Visibility:

Deployment of a centralized digital platform to monitor and track truck movements.

Enhancing transparency in material handling operations through real-time updates.

Axestrack has three layered approaches to Governance

Steering committee and value board: This layer will have the executive sponsor for the project with one-to-one mapping with the Ather Energy Sponsors level management. The team will meet monthly/quarterly to validate and monitor the project progress and take strategic decisions. This layer is the highest level of escalation,

Enagament & project management: This layer provides the project level monitoring and management. They will deal with the day-to-day operation issues and escalations. This layer will be responsible for the project success and excellence.

Project operations & transformation: This layer involves all the members of execution team including Technical SPOCs, functional SPOCs and SMEs. These will interact with the client project team on daily basis and work for the success of the project.

Civil work, mounting poles, power supply, LAN/ Wi-Fi connectivity, hardware setup, if any, are out of scope for the project

Ather Energy to provide the Stagewise actions, thresholds for each checklist/checkpoint and escalation matrix for exception management to configure the process flow.

Ather Energy will provide the timely approvals and sign-off for the work products (Hardware & Digital Layer) delivered as part of project.

Coordination with Third Party Agents/Admin Staff for data inputs in CPL digital layer will be done by Ather Energy team.

Any new requirements beyond the scope of this proposal will be considered as change request for which separate effort & cost to be estimated.

Data extraction, cleansing, validation & reconciliation from SAP will be done by Ather Energy business users.

Issues and bugs related to 3rd Party product or services or plugins will be out of scope for this project.

All project deliverables will be in English.

Local language support or any translation requirement to be supported by Ather Energy.

Any hardware requirement will be charged separately.

All communication with ERP will be through API Integration

Axestrack will be dependent on Ather Energy for any delay due to major deviation, weather/environmental conditions, new requirements and non-availability of Ather Energy SPOCs (users & project team) resulting in project timeline delay will not be Axestrack responsibility.

Train the trainer approach will be followed for the user training

Ather Energy need to provide all the required approvals and passes to the Axestrack Onsite team (if required during project implementation) at Plant. Also, Ather Energy will be responsible to provide required Safety Training & PPE’s to Axestrack’s team, wherever applicable.

breadcrumb: Pragmatic View of Product Roadmap & Innovations Planned
content:
Axestrack’s product roadmap has been built keeping current and future needs of the industry in scope. The roadmap establishes our commitment to the innovations and capabilities which we co-develop with client to ensure these developments are relevant to the needs of the clients.

Our solutions for inbound movement, in-plant automation, outbound movement, logistics platform and many more brings together real-time visibility, actionable insights, and intelligent control, enabling businesses to predict, prevent, and resolve challenges before they escalate.

Our impact is far-reaching, with aOS managing over 250,000 commercial vehicles globally, for 100+ clients and enabling smarter logistics across diverse industries like Cement, Metals & Minerals, Automobile, FMCG, E-commerce, Chemical, etc. Whether it’s fleet owners, consignors, plants, or port authorities, we deliver tailored solutions that drive efficiency and compliance.

Recognized globally and trusted locally, Axestrack is committed to shaping the future of logistics. We are investing in advanced telematics, IoT integrations, and cloud-based control towers to ensure our clients stay ahead in an ever-evolving landscape.

With Axestrack, every journey becomes smarter, safer, and future-ready.

breadcrumb: Business Requirements > Business Need and Why
content:
ATUL Limited operates large-scale chemical manufacturing units in Valsad and Ankleshwar, dispatching finished goods to domestic depots and ports (Hazira & Nhava Sheva) through market fleet transporters. With over 50 trips daily managed by 21 transporters, the company requires real-time visibility, trip compliance, and accountability across its outbound operations.

Their existing SIM-based and API-based tracking methods have proven ineffective due to dependency on external fleets, lack of SIM consent, and inconsistent data availability. To maintain operational excellence, safety compliance, and on-time deliveries, ATUL needs a reliable GPS-based plug-and-play solution with integrated reverse logistics and ERP/TMS connectivity.

Inability to track market fleet vehicles due to SIM and API consent issues.

Lack of unified trip visibility across multi-destination and port-bound routes.

Manual coordination with transporters causing delays and higher turnaround time (TAT).

Absence of structured reverse logistics leading to device loss and poor asset utilization.

Non-standardized proof of delivery and safety compliance monitoring.

These challenges result in limited visibility, data gaps, non-compliance, and higher operational costs, directly impacting supply chain efficiency and delivery reliability.

ATUL Limited operates manufacturing plants — Valsad being major chemical production hubs. Their logistics involve multi-destination and single-destination trips handled by 21 transporters, with outbound movements to Hazira and Nhava Sheva ports along with domestic depots.

Axestrack proposes a GPS-based Plug & Play Tracking Solution with integrated Reverse Logistics Management, ePOD, and MCT-based Safety Monitoring to provide ATUL full visibility, accountability, and compliance across its outbound and inbound operations.

section_title: Reverse Logistics Based GPS, ePOD and MCT Solutions
breadcrumb: Proposed Solution > Reverse Logistics Based GPS, ePOD and MCT Solutions
content:
Key Features:

Unified digital portal for real time tracking.

Real time alerts on non-compliances enroute.

Centralized Manage Control Tower (MCT) for proactive monitoring and exception management.

ePOD (Electronic Proof of Delivery) for seamless trip closure and digital confirmation of deliveries

Risk reports and advanced analytics

Easy installation/uninstallation using plug and play devices.

Streamlined reverse logistics.

Advanced analytics using Xsights.

Value Impact:

Enhanced Visibility

Cost Optimization

Enhanced delivery compliance with real-time proof of delivery.

Streamlined operations with centralized MCT oversight.

Informed Decision making and accountability

The Logistics Process Flow for ATUL Limited ensures secure and transparent movement of finished chemical products from plants to ports and domestic depots through Axestrack’s GPS-based Plug-and-Play solution integrated with the XSwift Platform.

The process begins with Loading, where goods are verified and loaded at the Valsad plant. In the GPS Installation Stage, a plug-and-play device is activated and mapped to the trip via the Axestrack app. Trip details including vehicle, driver, and route information are then created in the XSwift Platform, enabling live trip tracking and alert management.

During the In-Transit Phase, XSwift provides real-time visibility with alerts for route deviation, overspeeding, stoppages, and other exceptions. The Monitoring & Control Tower (MCT) team ensures safety and compliance by actively managing alerts and transporter coordination.

At the Destination, unloading and delivery are confirmed through ePOD, capturing photographic and digital proof. Post-delivery, the Reverse Logistics Process begins — GPS devices are retrieved either by trained drivers or managed directly by Axestrack. Returned devices undergo testing and inventory logging for redeployment in future trips.

This streamlined process ensures real-time visibility, safety compliance, and efficient device management, reducing operational delays and enhancing control across ATUL’s logistics network.

Trip Management:
Creation, monitoring, and closure of single and multi-destination trips across ports and domestic depots.

Real-Time Tracking:
Continuous GPS-based monitoring of all active vehicles through the XSwift Platform with live status, route progress, and TAT analytics.

Exception Management:
Real-time alerts for deviations, stoppages, over speeding, and unauthorized route changes with escalation workflows.

Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD):
Digital confirmation of deliveries with photo capture, timestamp, and consignee acknowledgment.

Reverse Logistics Management:
Structured process for GPS device retrieval, testing, and redeployment — managed either by drivers or Axestrack.

Integration & Reporting:
Automated data exchange with SAP ERP for unified dashboards and performance reports.

Hardware:
Plug-and-play GPS devices compatible with multiple vehicle types; equipped for quick installation and removal.

Platform:
XSwift, Axestrack’s unified logistics visibility and analytics platform, providing a secure, cloud-based interface for live monitoring, alerts, analytics, and reporting.

Connectivity:
Real-time communication through GSM/GPRS with fallback to offline data buffering; data hosted on secure cloud infrastructure with high availability.

Integration Framework:
RESTful API integration with SAP ERP to enable real-time data synchronization, event updates, and trip status visibility.

Data & Analytics:
Centralized data repository with AI-driven dashboards, TAT analysis, and insights for performance optimization.

Security & Compliance:
End-to-end data encryption, role-based access control, and compliance with IT security standards and ISO guidelines.

Scalability:
Modular architecture allowing seamless addition of new transporters, routes, or devices without system downtime.
